article-meta.related-article: This corrects the article "Analysis of the efficacy of subclinical doses of esketamine in combination with propofol in non-intubated general anesthesia procedures - a systematic review and meta-analysis", 245.

body.p: Following publication of the original article [1], the authors reported an error found in affiliation 1. The correct affiliations should be “Department of Anesthesiology, Affiliated Hospital of Southwest Medical University, Luzhou, China” instead of “Southwest Medical University, Luzhou, China.”.
The original article [1] has been updated.

fn.p: The online version of the original article can be found at 10.1186/s12871-023-02135-8.
Springer Nature remains neutral with regard to jurisdictional claims in published maps and institutional affiliations.
Haoming Chen and Xizhi Ding contributed equally to this work.
